title: Dependency identity test changes multiple cache inputs at once
reasoning: Changing test_dependencies also changes the generated pyproject.toml, and the test uses different project paths. Therefore, differing environment IDs do not establish that the declared test_dependencies field participates in cache identity. An implementation that ignores that field for identity but hashes pyproject.toml could satisfy every assertion, including writing test_dependencies.json.
reproduction: Omit test_dependencies from cache identity while retaining pyproject.toml hashing and dependency manifest writing. The supplied scenario still produces different identities.
recommendation: Keep the project path and project/lock bytes fixed while varying only ProblemConfig.test_dependencies, then verify distinct identities and reuse for repeated identical declarations.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing scenario cannot distinguish dependency-field identity from changes to other identity inputs.
suggestedRegressionTest: Expand the existing identity scenario with configurations sharing identical project files and path but differing declared test dependencies; verify separate environments and reuse for identical declarations.
